rules: Domain recommendations and missing exact manufacturer-profile coverage are advisories, not navigation blockers.
Operator may select any plan card and move from PLAN to PREPARATION.
Technical integrity is checked separately before an execution can be completed.
An empty ingredient list is a technical impossibility for automated mixer execution because ARGUS has no values to execute; it is not an agronomic veto.
Timers and advisories never gate the next screen.
Persistence failure may prevent marking an execution as completed because the history record would otherwise be false.
